basis: Constellation’s July 1 earnings release first established the threshold crossing. For Q1 FY2026, the three months ended May 31, 2025, the consolidated GAAP table reported net sales after excise taxes of $2,515.0 million versus $2,661.8 million a year earlier. The decline was 5.52%, placing sales $13.71 million below the $2,528.71 million cutoff. The earlier disclosures reviewed gave no numeric upper bound for this quarter’s consolidated reported net sales.

coverage.detail: January 10, preceding earnings cycle. The Q3 FY2025 release projected 2% to 5% enterprise organic net sales growth for the fiscal year ending February 2025. The accompanying call’s quarter-specific wine outlook concerned Q4 FY2025 shipment volumes.

April 9, immediately preceding earnings release. The FY2026 enterprise organic net sales outlook was −2% to +1%. Its annual comparison excluded $98 million of prior-year SVEDKA sales and $613 million associated with the wine transaction. It supplied no Q1 FY2026 consolidated sales range.
April 9 investor presentation. Management presented FY2025 results and FY2026–FY2028 outlooks. The sales projections covered fiscal years and did not establish a Q1 reported-sales ceiling.
April 10 earnings call. Management identified Q1 as the toughest prior-year comparison and said it generally did not give quarterly guidance. It gave no numeric consolidated Q1 sales forecast.
April 23 Form 10-K. Management expected beer depletions to outpace shipments most notably in Q1 FY2026. That described the relative timing of beer volumes and gave no consolidated dollar-sales bound.
May 13 Goldman Sachs forum. Asked about current-quarter beer volumes, management declined to give quarterly or monthly figures. The 6.4% cited in the response described the prior-year comparison.
June 2 wine transaction closing. The sale closed after the May 31 quarter end. Constellation reaffirmed its annual FY2026–FY2028 outlooks and supplied no preliminary Q1 revenue figure.

June 3 Deutsche Bank conference. Management discussed consumer demand, beer margins and restructuring savings. Its public remarks gave no Q1 consolidated net sales amount or year-over-year decline range.

The issuer’s release archive identifies May 29 as the results scheduling notice, June 2 as the wine closing and debt redemption announcements, and July 1 at 4:05 p.m. EDT as publication of Q1 FY2026 results.

July 1 actuals. The net sales reconciliation confirms the perimeter. Reported prior-year consolidated sales were $2,661.8 million. Removing $36.0 million of SVEDKA sales produces the separate $2,625.8 million organic comparison and a rounded 4% organic decline.
July 2 Form 10-Q confirms the same consolidated net sales and quarter labels one day after the public release.

publication_date_evidence: Constellation’s IR archive timestamps the Q1 FY2026 results release July 1, 2025 at 4:05 p.m. EDT. The same-day Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 contains the comparative GAAP table. The earnings call and Form 10-Q followed on July 2.
